title: IDrive Photo Backup
summary: Secure your mobile photos and videos, PCs, and Macs!
description:
IDrive® Photo Backup

. Simple backup and restore app for mobile photos and videos

. Backup for PC and Mac

. Original resolution

. Faster than most competing services

IDrive® Photos Features:

- Save all photos and videos from your Android phone.
- Backup your PCs and Macs, including the photos on them.
- The Entire phone gallery will be automatically backed up and kept up to date.
- Backup all the photos and videos in their original resolution.
- Restore selected photos or entire gallery from the cloud.
- Share backed up photos with your friends and family.
- Use timeline to view the pictures from a particular time period.

For more info, visit https://www.idrive.com/photos/
